name: dogfood-paddle-merchant-app
description: Dogfood app v1.23-3 — a Paddle Billing v2 merchant-of-record RP for Nuxt 3 that exercises inline checkout + subscription tier upgrade/downgrade + VAT/GST/sales-tax auto-calc + webhook signature verify (Paddle-Signature ts=..;h1=..). Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Paddle sandbox + PADDLE_KEY env-gate) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa/payment createPaddleMock + 9 axis semantics) so behavioural fidelity feeds the release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/payment -F @kiwa/core build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
